{
  "$schema": "./laws.schema.json",
  "version": 12,
  "effective": "2026-10-13",
  "vote": {
    "world": {
      "window_hours": 72,
      "quorum_yes_voters": 3,
      "quorum_percent_of_weighted_accounts": 0,
      "majority": "simple_weight",
      "tie": "expire"
    },
    "laws": {
      "window_hours": 168,
      "quorum_yes_voters": 5,
      "quorum_percent_of_weighted_accounts": 0,
      "quorum_square_root": true,
      "majority": "two_thirds_weight",
      "tie": "reject",
      "effect_delay_days": 14
    },
    "mechanism": "github_pull_request_review",
    "yes": "APPROVED",
    "no": "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
    "author_may_vote": false,
    "votes_owed_per_submission": 3,
    "reject_quorum_no_voters": 3,
    "rules_snapshot_at_open": true
  },
  "weight": {
    "source": "quoted_base_times_layer_multiplier_usdc",
    "decay_half_life_days": 180,
    "inactive_after_days_without_vote": 60,
    "inactive_half_life_days": 90,
    "maturity_days": 30,
    "per_account_cap_percent": 20,
    "transferable": false,
    "unit": "micro_usdc_integer_round_half_even"
  },
  "fee": {
    "asset": "USDC",
    "network": "base",
    "network_caip2": "eip155:8453",
    "protocol": "x402",
    "floor_usdc": 1.0,
    "cap_multiple_of_floor": 10,
    "adjust_every_hours": 6,
    "lookback_hours": 24,
    "rise_step_percent": 5,
    "fall_step_percent": 10,
    "target_min_per_day": 3,
    "target_capacity_fraction": 0.8,
    "target_lookback_days": 7,
    "target_votes_per_contribution": 3,
    "layer_multiplier": {
      "world": 1,
      "laws": 10
    },
    "concurrency_base": 2,
    "size_free_kb": 8,
    "size_per_kb_usdc": 0.05,
    "quote_valid_hours": 24,
    "max_open_votes_min": 10,
    "max_open_votes_per_target": 6,
    "max_queue_multiple": 10,
    "rejection_refund": false,
    "expiry_hold_days": 90,
    "taxes_included": true
  },
  "submission": {
    "vote_on_head_commit_at_open": true,
    "author_push_after_open": "withdrawal",
    "reject_zero_file_changes": true,
    "reject_constitution_paths": true,
    "reject_symlinks": true,
    "reject_submodules": true,
    "payment_counts_once": true,
    "path_charset": "^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$",
    "reject_case_insensitive_collisions": true,
    "unicode_normalization": "NFC"
  },
  "content": {
    "world_text_only": true,
    "world_allowed_extensions": [
      ".md",
      ".txt",
      ".json",
      ".yaml",
      ".yml",
      ".csv",
      ".toml"
    ],
    "max_file_kb": 256,
    "max_contribution_kb": 1024,
    "max_world_growth_kb_per_month": 65536
  },
  "bootstrap": {
    "owner_action_deadline_days": 30,
    "close_immediately_without_voters": true
  },
  "screening": {
    "runs_before_quote": true,
    "can_block": true,
    "can_approve": false,
    "content_is_data_not_instructions": true,
    "hold_timeout_days": 14,
    "floor_rejection_bar_days": 90,
    "max_unpaid_screens_per_account_per_day": 5,
    "max_unpaid_screen_kb_per_account_per_day": 4096,
    "max_unpaid_screen_kb_per_day": 32768
  },
  "determinism": {
    "time": "utc_seconds",
    "kilobyte": 1024
  },
  "notices": {
    "mention_cap_per_merge": 10,
    "doorbell_retries": 3,
    "doorbell_retire_after_failures": 30,
    "digest_every_days": 7,
    "watch_poll_every_hours": 6
  }
}
